claude_proposed_widenings.name: permanent_feat_grant family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Epic Boon grants a feat permanently at level-up. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence — all inapplicable to a permanent one-time character acquisition. No family exists for level-up progression grants.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureEffect has no variant for feat acquisition. Existing variants are grant_extra_action and heal_hp, both of which are runtime effects of an activated feature. A feat grant is a permanent character ability acquisition during character progression, not a runtime activated effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Fate is recommended.
